scientific_integrity: Universal proof from Pfaffian syzygies and coefficient derivatives. Exact finite symbolic checks for odd matrix orders 3, 5 and 7; these checks are not a proof for all dimensions. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The universal identity applies to the full quadratic Veronese dual in characteristic two, with even projective dimension at least four. Generic transverse length only on corank-three stratum; no detailed deeper-stratum primary decomposition claimed. Historical priority for scheme equality remains provisional.
title: The first Pfaffian neighborhood of the characteristic-two Veronese dual
